svg.title: Doddy V4 redesign comparison
svg.text: Same Doddy. A different way to show up.
The character and the action now form one useful little instrument.
From a corner avatar and flat oval to a precise face-centred dial.
From a completion bowl to a thought token being tucked safely away.
From two bottom strokes to sculpted ink, a listening hand and voice energy.
From language initials on a line to two recognisable dialogue forms.
All sixteen boards have new vector compositions; previous versions are preserved.
Static mockups / motion proposed / native behaviour untested
